goal: Create a Java 17 Maven application that uses Spring XML configuration to start an embedded Apache Ignite 2.18.0 node. Define a Protocol class with protocolVersion (int), softwareVersion (int), dataLength (int), time (long) and body (byte[]), and a ProtocolParser with encode(Protocol) returning byte[] and decode(byte[]) returning Protocol, using this wire format: a 9-byte big-endian header (protocolVersion 1 byte, softwareVersion 1 byte, dataLength 3 bytes, time 4 bytes) followed by the raw body bytes. In the application, create a sample Protocol (protocolVersion 1, softwareVersion 2, time 1700000000, body "Hello, Protocol" as UTF-8), encode it, decode it, store the decoded Protocol in an Ignite cache, read it back from the cache and check that it equals the original. Print one line in the format [RESULT] protocolVersion=X, softwareVersion=Y, dataLength=Z, time=T, bodyLength=B, equals=<the real comparison result>. Include a JUnit test that proves the ProtocolParser round trip, close all Spring and Ignite resources so the application exits normally, and make the application runnable with Maven.
